Cellosaurus DI 'NCIt C8263 Adult acute monocytic leukemia' (also MDS); MONDO:0000875

claims.value: THP-1 1Y male Japanese; MOLM-13 20Y male Japanese

claims.location: characteristics[sampling site] all rows; characteristics[organism part] all rows
claims.evidence: Cellosaurus 'Derived from site: In situ; Peripheral blood; UBERON_0000178' for both lines. organism part left 'not applicable' for cultured cell-line material (sdrf-tools reconcile rule)

claims.location: characteristics[sample storage] and factor value[sample storage], rows with SDS/DMSO/PELLET in the run name
claims.value: lysed in 4% SDS and stored at -80 °C | cryopreserved in medium with 20% FBS and 10% DMSO in liquid nitrogen | dried cell pellet stored in liquid nitrogen
claims.evidence: Paper 4.2 / PRIDE sample protocol describe the three aliquots: SDS lysate at -80 °C, RPMI with 20% FBS/10% DMSO in liquid nitrogen, dried pellet in liquid nitrogen; run-name tokens SDS / DMSO / PELLET

claims.location: QC rows 10-15 (source 'MOLM-13 QC pool', 'THP-1 QC pool')
claims.value: pooled; biological replicate pooled; technical replicate 1-3; sample storage pooled
claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'A pool containing equal amounts of all the samples was used as QC and analyzed three times'; Figure S2 caption: 'QC samples are a pool of the replicates for each of the cell line samples'
Run/experiment suffix -1/-2/-3; Figure S2 'triplicates of each preservation method'; paired t-tests in paper 4.4. Biological (vs technical) nature of the triplicates is inferred
Raw header 'Orbitrap Elite MS', tune 'Elite_nano', folder '2017-03-30_OrbitrapElite_Freezing-effect'; paper 4.4 'THP-1 and Molm-13 samples were analyzed on an Orbitrap Elite'

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], [collision energy], [ms2 mass analyzer], [ms1 scan range]
claims.evidence: Scan events 'FTMS + p norm o(300.0-2000.0)', 'ITMS + c norm Dep Wideband MS/MS', 'Activation Type: CID', 'Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0', method 05b_TOP12CID_240K..._CE35
parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.6 Da'; MS2 was acquired in the ion trap
summary.txt Enzyme=Trypsin, mode Specific for every raw file; PRIDE data processing protocol 'Trypsin was set as protease'; paper 4.4 'Trypsin was used as digestion protease'

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (UNIMOD:4, C, Fixed); Oxidation (UNIMOD:35, M, Variable); Acetyl (UNIMOD:1, Protein N-term, Variable)
claims.evidence: parameters.txt 'Fixed modifications: Carbamidomethyl (C)'; summary.txt 'Variable modifications: Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term)' for every raw file; matches paper section 4.4

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method] all rows
claims.evidence: Raw-file method names TOP12CID / TOP12HCD (top-12 data-dependent MS/MS); PRIDE experiment type Shotgun proteomics
PRIDE quantification 'MS1 intensity based label-free quantification'; paper 4.4 LFQ mode; summary.txt multiplicity 1, no labels

limitations: Biological vs technical nature of the -1/-2/-3 triplicates is not stated; annotated as biological replicates 1-3.
QC pools encoded as one pooled source per cell line with technical replicates 1-3.
Instrument/acquisition settings read from 2 of 24 raw headers; the rest assumed identical (same folder and search).
Precursor mass tolerance omitted: MaxQuant 1.5 parameters.txt does not report it and no mqpar.xml was deposited.
Culture medium, passage number and numeric liquid-nitrogen storage temperature are not stated; columns omitted.
characteristics[sample storage] / factor value[sample storage] is free text outside the ms-proteomics/human/cell-lines templates.
